scope: independent root audit of the same-s cross-parity resultant, even-overlap localization, fixed-M parity selection, and declared selected-parity control

mathematical_audit.quadric_table: direct expansion of the Item-317 readout gives the eight displayed rational quadrics, with every omitted denominator a p-unit on actual rows
mathematical_audit.resultant: for each phase the difference of the two monic A-quadrics is plus or minus 8(X^2+Y^2), hence the resultant is exactly 64(X^2+Y^2)^2
mathematical_audit.even_overlap: even s gives p congruent to 3 modulo 4, so a simultaneous parity zero forces X=Y=A=0 and therefore an Item-321 Casoratian zero
mathematical_audit.fixed_M_mass: Item 321 localizes the Casoratian zero to h=1 or p dividing Q(s); the division-free fixed-M identity places all latter distinct primes in the nonzero quadratic 330M^2-235M+18, giving O(log M) logarithmic mass
mathematical_audit.odd_geometry: odd s gives p congruent to 1 modulo 4 and the four displayed projective representatives exactly solve both quadrics after j^2=-1
mathematical_audit.selection_scope: s increases by 3 at fixed M while h decreases by 4, so the actual gate selects one constant parity; neither Item 308 nor the original gate forces the unused parity
mathematical_audit.control_scope: the exact p=47 row verifies only the selected Item-308 eliminant/container event and is not promoted to a full Item-264 collision

PROVED: even-row simultaneous-parity localization to thin Casoratian support
